resources.string: This section is being prepared. It will come in one of the next updates.
Alerts come in version 1.1. Until then keep the official “Air Alert” app and always listen to the sirens.
Could not open your data yet
Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
Your saved data cannot be opened

The key to it is no longer on this phone, for example after a reset or damage to the key file. The guide, cards and calls work as usual. A fresh start sets the old data aside on the phone without deleting it, but Sprotyv will not be able to open it again.
Set the old data aside and start fresh? Sprotyv will not be able to open the old data.
The key fits, but the data itself would not open, for example after a failed update. Nothing was deleted. Try again. If it keeps failing, you can set the old data aside and start fresh.
This phone keeps the key in software only, without secure hardware. Your data is encrypted, but less well protected than on most phones.
Not found. The guide may have been updated; go back and open it again.
Not yet reviewed by a specialist. Official instructions come first.
Licence: %1$s. You may copy and change it with credit, under the same licence.
This part of the built-in content could not be opened. Please update the app. Calls below still work.
Everything here is encrypted and stays on this phone. Sprotyv sends nothing by itself.
For “I am safe” and in an emergency
The list from the guide, tick what you have
How much water and food for your household
What rescuers and doctors need to know if you cannot tell them. Fill in only what you want.
Not chosen yet. In Trusted people, switch on “Contact in an emergency”.
Who gets your “I am safe” message and whom to call if something happens to you.
I am safe. I will get in touch later.
First add the people who should get the message.
SMS works without the internet. An SMS to one person is the surest: several numbers at once may go as an MMS, which needs mobile data. The app opens; press Send there.
Sprotyv sends nothing itself: it only opens the app with the text ready.
Make the plan together. Everyone should know it by heart; keep a paper copy too, as phones run out of power.
If you must leave the building
If you cannot stay near home
If the town must be left
A relative in another town or country whom everyone calls when they cannot reach each other.
Write it plainly: “if… then…”. Such a plan is easier to remember and follow.
e.g. we go to the corridor, the bag is by the door
e.g. takes the bag and turns off the gas
Twice a year walk the routes to the shelter and the meeting points, by day and in the evening.
The list from the guide. Tick what is already in the bag. Each adult needs their own bag.
Twice a year check expiry dates of food and medicines and charge the power banks.
Start small: three days is a goal anyone can reach. Then two weeks, then a month.
4 litres a person a day: 2 to drink, 2 for cooking and washing.
Buy what you usually eat, 20–30% more than the norm, and put new stock at the back: then nothing expires.
The last change could not be saved. Check that the phone has free space, then change it again.
Your data needs an app update
This version cannot open your saved data. Nothing was deleted. Install the next update; the guide, cards and calls work as usual.
Could not read your data. Nothing was changed. Go back and open it again.
Write the number with the country code, e.g. +380…, or as 0XXXXXXXXX: otherwise WhatsApp may open the wrong chat.
Blood group, allergies, medicines, contact as a QR code
Only what helps in the first minutes, without your name or date of birth. Any phone camera reads this code; no app is needed.
QR code with your key medical facts
Anyone who sees the code can read it. Show and keep it only where you are fine with that.
You can set the picture as the lock screen in the phone settings. Then anyone can see it without unlocking the phone.
Fill in the medical card first: blood group, allergies, medicines.
Plan, medical card and contacts on paper
Phones run out of power. Keep a paper copy at home and in the bag.
Save the PDF: plan, medical card, contacts
Personal. Keep it where strangers cannot see it.

Anyone who gets the file can read your medical data and plan. If you save it to a folder that syncs to a cloud, it will be copied there too. Save it only where you decide, and delete it after printing if it is not needed.
Could not save. Try another place.
What to do now: action cards
Save the cards as a PDF for printing
With the phone camera, no permission needed

The phone’s own camera takes the picture; Sprotyv reads the code on the phone and deletes its copy. Some camera apps also keep a copy in the gallery: check and delete it there if needed. Nothing opens without your choice.
Take a photo of the code
No QR code found. Take the photo closer and in good light.
Fake codes are stuck on top of real ones. Open only if you trust the address.
It will open in another app: %1$s. Do not enter passwords or card numbers there unless you are sure.
The connection is not protected (no https).
Before “@” is a fake address; the real one comes after it.
The address uses look-alike letters from other alphabets.
The address is bare numbers, not a name.
The address has many parts; check its real end.
Some text did not fit and was shortened. Keep the fields short.
No camera app found on the phone. Choose a picture instead.
